QuestInfo.name: [Collector's Request] In Search of the Legend
QuestInfo.0: The Collector who seeks anything of value seems to have a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: The Collector wants a #brelic of legendary hero Sayram.#k However, there are no clues to follow. The Collector tells you to start with the #bancient book about Sayram's legend#k in the possession of #bWiz the Librarian#k in Helios Tower.
QuestInfo.2: You met #bWiz the Librarian#k in Helios Tower.

0.0: Hello, you can call me the #bCollector#k. I seek all the riches Maple World has to offer.
0.1: Grandis remains an untapped well, but all in due time.
0.2: In any case, do you know of the #blegendary hero Sayram#k? He's the very first Warrior. The Warrior of Warriors, an example for all adventurers.
0.3: I'll take your lack of reaction to mean you've somehow never heard of him. The trouble with this legend is that he remains just that. We lack definitive proof that he truly walked these lands. That proof is what I seek.
0.4: Where did the Great Warrior #bSayram#k's journey end? And were any of his effects left behind? A cherished #brelic#k, perhaps? We don't know.
0.5: But someone called #bWiz the Librarian#k in Helios Library discovered an #bancient book about Sayram #k. Naturally, his primary concern is ascertaining the authenticity of the book, but I, the Collector, have a different aim.
0.6: Use it to track Sayram's path and bring back anything you can find. Believe me when I say you'll be handsomely rewarded.

yes.0: Excellent. I'll make sure this is fruitful for us both.
yes.1: No more dilly-dallying. Off you go to Helios Library!

no.0: I hope you'll reconsider. Come see me when you do.

1.0: Greetings, young one! I am Wiz the Librarian, but you may--
